comments:
(Copying my comment from [here](https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/103011#issuecomment-1548010494)):

Looks like `planner.stmt` field is only set in `copyMachine.insertRowsInternal` which might not be called in some code path (if we short-circuit before we get to processing). Similar bug was fixed in bf56cbf44485d567f015a172eab611daa703634b (but there `txn` wasn't set).

`planner.stmt` is also set in `setCopyLoggingFields`, which is called unconditionally here: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/dc5c429acb69496f1f7678bf41e608c05f1062d8/pkg/sql/conn_executor.go#L2920

which is before the place where `maybeLogStatement` is called in a `defer`.

So this must mean something is unsetting `planner.stmt`.

Ah I see, `preparePlannerForCopy` calls `resetPlanner`, which does clear the `planner.stmt`.

`preparePlannerForCopy` is called at the beginning of `newFileUploadMachine` and `newCopyMachine`. So I think if either of these last two functions return an error, this panic might occur. Working on a repro.

review_comments: should we delete `resetPlanner` from the `copyTxnOpt` struct too?
oops my fix is invalid. i forgot about the mode where we batch copies and call this `resetPlanner` in between each batch.
